data.long_meaning: The Old English name Orton comes from the Old English words 'ort' meaning 'place' or 'dwelling' and 'ton' meaning 'town' or 'settlement'. It was a name given to someone who lived in a prosperous village or town. The name Orton carries the meaning “Wealthy man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orton usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
